name: Cavalry
overview: Scripture depicts cavalry as a powerful military force, often mounted on horses or camels, representing strength and swiftness in battle. The pursuit of enemies by horsemen and chariots is vividly illustrated in Exodus 14:23 and Jeremiah 4:29, while Isaiah 31:1 warns against placing trust in such earthly might instead of the Holy One of Israel. Ultimately, true victory belongs to those who rely on the LORD, as Zechariah 10:5 affirms that the riders on horses will be confounded when God fights for His people. The vast number of horsemen in Revelation 9:16 further underscores the prominence of cavalry in biblical warfare imagery.
